profile.ja: 対魔忍。次元侵略者・ブレインフレーヤーによって支配された終末世界のアスカ。雷神ゆきかぜの親友にして最高の戦友。時空を超える実験に失敗して手足を失う前の体になり、アンドロイドアーム＆レッグを失うも、ゆきかぜと切磋琢磨する中で風遁の術を極め“風神アスカ”と称されるほどに成長を遂げている。ブレインフレーヤーとの死闘の中で戦死した“仮面の対魔忍”や“最強の対魔忍”の遺志を引き継ぎ、絶対的支配者に従順ならざる人々をまとめ導いている未来のリーダー。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin. Asuka from a post-apocalyptic world dominated by the dimensional invader Brain Flayer. She is the best friend and ally of the Raijin Yukikaze. After failing an experiment that transcended time and space, she lost her limbs, but even after losing her android arms and legs, she honed her wind magic skills through her interactions with Yukikaze, earning her the title "Kazegami Asuka". She has inherited the will of the "Masked Taimanin" and the "Strongest Taimanin", who died in battle against the Brain Flayer, and is leading those who refuse to obey the absolute ruler.

text.ja: やっほ！　びっくりした？　未来からきた甲河アスカよ！　……過去の間違いじゃないかって？　色々あってこうなっちゃったの！
text.en: Hey there! Surprised? I'm Asuka from the future! ...Or should I say, this isn't a mistake from the past? A lot happened, and that's how I ended up like this!

text.ja: もー、だから私もどうしてこうなったかまでは分からないって言ってるでしょー？　ま、心配してくれてるのは嬉しいけど♪
text.en: Geez, I'm telling you, I don't even know how I ended up like this! But it's nice that you're worried about me, though.

text.ja: 子供扱いされても怒らないのかって？　ふふ、勘違いされている方が色々と便利でしょ？　あはは、伊達に歳は重ねてないわ
text.en: You're not mad that I'm being treated like a kid? Hehe, it's actually pretty convenient when people misunderstand me. Ahaha, I haven't lived this long for nothing!

text.ja: 人をまとめる立場になって、所長やふうまがどれだけの重圧を感じていたか、分かるようになったわ……たまにはその重荷、分けてよね
text.en: Now that I'm in a position to lead others, I've come to understand the pressure that the director and Fuuma must have felt... Sometimes, I wish you'd share that burden with me.

text.ja: 私の正体が実は、アスカママとあんたとの子だーって言ったら、どうするー？　お、俺がアスカを間違えるはずないって……反則よっ！
text.en: If I told you that my true identity is actually the child of Asuka-mama and you, what would you do? Oh, you wouldn't mistake me for Asuka, would you? That's just cheating!

text.ja: ゆきかぜとはもうすっかり親友よ。本当はね、ずっとライバルでいたかったけど……何のことかって、あんたは分からなくていいの！
text.en: Yukikaze and I are already the best of friends. To be honest, I always wanted to be rivals with her, but... never mind, you don't need to know that!

text.ja: 義肢を失ったからこそ風遁を極められたけれど、あの頃の戦い方も忘れられないのよね……あはは、大丈夫、自分から切ったりしないって
text.en: Although I lost my prosthetic limbs, I was able to master wind magic. I still remember how I used to fight back then, though... Ahaha, don't worry, I won't cut myself or anything.

text.ja: 自分の手足が戻ってもそこまで変化は感じなかったかな……それだけ、エンジニアのみんなが努力してくれてたって事なんだろうけど
text.en: Even when my limbs were restored, I didn't feel that much of a difference... I guess that's because the engineers worked really hard, though.

text.ja: ね、ねえ、だっこして？　んっ……そのまま、ぎゅーってしてぇ……はあぁぁ、この体だと、あんたの逞しさ、いっぱい感じれるぅ
text.en: Hey, hey, give me a hug? Nn... just like that, squeeze me tight... Ahhh, with this body, I can feel your strength so much...

text.ja: ふうまのざ～こ♪　よわよわ♪　ふふ、こういうのが流行ってるんでしょ？　え、その後？　知らないけど……あっ、ちょっと、あんっ！？
text.en: Fuuma's so soft and weak! Hehe, I've heard that's what's popular these days, right? What happens next? I don't know, though... Ah, wait, just a minute, ahn!

text.ja: あっ……んっ……生身の手足で触れ合う感覚ぅ……センサーからの情報と変わらないはずなのに……あったかくて、気持ちいい……
text.en: Ah... nn... the feeling of being touched with real limbs... It's not that different from the information I get from my sensors, but it's warm and feels so good...
